releases.notes: Windows development pilot with an offline walkthrough, invite-only cloud sign-in, guided lesson flows, optional pointing, and separately approved single-action demonstrations. Includes the .NET runtime. This portable ZIP is unsigned; broader real-workflow and accessibility qualification is still in progress.

Latest pilot: describe a goal to let Gemini choose a browser and starting site, or use Ctrl+Alt+Space for an existing window. Live screenshot guidance now uses a compact companion, drawn cursor/ring/callout, Find click target, Check screen, loading-state handling and interrupted-response recovery. Screenshot-only guidance; offline walkthroughs and browser control inspection are disabled. You click and type; autonomous execution is not included. Requires an invited pilot account and internet. Unsigned; full native workflows, voice and accessibility remain under qualification.
